generator.description: Each instance is a portfolio of n synthetic findings (one finding = one candidate remediation action). Findings use the same draw rules as benchmarks/qiro_optimality.py::instance; only n is fixed per size and the constraints come from a sampled tightness τ instead of fixed budget / downtime levels.

tippss_mapping.distribution: k ~ U{1, 2, 3} pillars sampled uniformly without replacement
tippss_mapping.note: a Safety pillar adds the +20 safety-criticality bonus

agent.note: agent pq_identification (or a PQ finding type) adds the +25 PQ-urgency bonus

catalogue_ranges.note: min / max over the remediation catalogue (illustrative placeholder values, not market data)

derived_coefficients.optimization_benefit: js_round(base_risk_reduction · sev_mult) + 25·[PQ] + 20·[Safety pillar] + js_round(10 · Σ pillar weights)
derived_coefficients.objective_coefficient: optimization_benefit − 0.5 · complexity (all values are integers or halves, so sums are exact in floating point)

generator.seeding: instances for size n are drawn from random.Random(f'{seed}-n{n}') so each size's instance set is independent of the other sizes requested; the k-th instance of a size runs qiro.optimize(seed=k); the small check uses random.Random(f'{seed}-small-check')

method.gap_formula: gap_pct = 100 · (f_ILP − f_method) / f_ILP per instance; instances with f_ILP = 0 are skipped and counted in skipped_zero_ilp_optimum
method.p95_gap_pct: sorted(gaps)[int(0.95 · (m − 1))] over the m evaluated instances (same estimator as qiro_optimality.py)

methods.greedy: greedy value-density start of qiro.optimize alone (optimality.greedy_objective)
methods.greedy_local_search: greedy start + the shipped deterministic best-improvement add / drop / swap local search (qiro._local_search), without annealing
methods.annealing_local_search: shipped QIRO pipeline: greedy start + simulated annealing + local-search polish (optimality.heuristic_objective)
methods.ilp: HiGHS MIP reference optimum via highspy with {'mip_rel_gap': 0.0, 'mip_abs_gap': 0.0} and time_limit=300 s; status 'Optimal' = proven optimal

runtime.greedy: wall time of the greedy start (replicated from qiro.optimize; its objective is checked against optimality.greedy_objective on every instance)
runtime.greedy_local_search: wall time of greedy start + qiro._local_search
runtime.annealing_local_search: wall time of qiro.optimize (includes building actions, annealing, local search and the explanation payload; the exhaustive solver is skipped for n > 14)
runtime.ilp: wall time of highspy model construction + HiGHS solve (solve_ms)
runtime.note: single-process wall-clock measurements on one machine; absolute values vary with hardware and load

method.annealing_schedule: iterations = min(3000, 200 + 80·n), T0 = 100, cooling 0.995, single-flip feasible moves (qiro.optimize)

small_check.description: ILP optimum vs. exhaustive optimum (qiro.exact_optimum) on instances from the same generator with n ~ U{3..14}

caveat: Synthetic random instances drawn from the illustrative remediation catalogue (placeholder costs, downtime and complexity values); not real hospital data. Runtimes are single-machine wall-clock measurements.
